name: 旧粉墙露砖
prompt: Create ONE square opaque seamless material texture filling every pixel. Reference 1 and 2 are approved final hand-painted environment materials; match broad brush-shaped masses and restrained contrast. Other refs guide painted contours and volume but DO NOT draw any prop or character. Worn warm pale plaster wall with one irregular area revealing dark muted red bricks beneath; several large broad patches and small cracks. Vertical wall flat elevation. Orthographic flat material swatch; NO isometric diamond, camera perspective, pedestal, lighting gradient, border, transparent area, text, rendered room, object shadow, photoreal micro-noise or PBR specular. Large readable painted shapes; visible but subdued wear, not neat showroom. Edges should tile or mirror smoothly.
